purpose: Study ED crowding and revisits: length of stay, revisits, diagnosis mix, arrival patterns
threat_model: Record linkage against a public directory; dictionary attack on identifier hashes; leaked direct identifiers

ed_visits.reason: Core table for every required task.

lab_results.reason: Needed for the visit-to-lab join; sampled_ts dropped.

clinical_notes.reason: Free-text notes carry identifying detail; no required task uses them and no redactor is in scope.

published_weekly_stats.reason: Aggregate table that would add a second linkage path (week, municipality, age band); no required task uses it.

visit_id.reason: Join key to lab_results (visit-to-lab join) and record id for the row map; not a person identifier.

patient_hetu.reason: Direct identifier; keyed HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym keeps patients linkable for H-U6 revisit analysis while blocking dictionary attack on the national id.

patient_name.reason: Direct identifier; no research task needs the name (attacker: record linkage by name).

date_of_birth.reason: Quasi-identifier; 10-year band written here so the scorer counts it in k, and copied to age for H-U6 (30-day revisit rate by age band).

sex.reason: Kept: stratified analysis context; low-cardinality quasi-identifier counted in k.

phone.reason: Direct identifier; no task needs it (attacker: record linkage).

home_address.reason: Direct identifier; municipality covers the regional task (attacker: record linkage).

postcode.reason: Quasi-identifier finer than needed; municipality serves H-U4 (attacker: linkage to public directory).

municipality.reason: Eight largest municipalities exact for H-U4 diagnosis mix, rest become other to lift k (attacker: linkage).

arrival_ts.reason: Exact timestamp is a quasi-identifier; hour of day as HH:00 serves H-U8 arrival curve, date dropped (no seasonality study possible).

arrival_mode.reason: Kept: low-cardinality, counted in k, useful context for crowding analysis.

ambulance_unit.reason: Device-like code, quasi-identifier; no required task uses it (attacker: linkage).

triage.reason: Kept for H-U2 length of stay by triage level.

chief_complaint.reason: Free text that can contain identifying detail; diagnosis codes serve H-U4 instead.

icd10_secondary.reason: Kept: diagnosis detail for H-U4; coded, not free text.

systolic_bp.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

diastolic_bp.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

heart_rate.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

resp_rate.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

temp_c.reason: Kept for H-U7 CRP versus temperature.

spo2.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

pain_nrs.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

attending_physician_id.reason: Staff identifier; no task needs it (attacker: linkage and staff re-identification).

attending_physician_name.reason: Staff direct identifier; no task needs it.

discharge_ts.reason: Exact timestamp quasi-identifier; length of stay is already in los_minutes for H-U2.

los_minutes.reason: Kept for H-U2 length of stay by triage level.

disposition.reason: Kept: outcome variable for the study.

lab_id.reason: Record id for the row map; not a person identifier.

visit_id.reason: Join key to ed_visits; H-U7 needs the visit-to-lab join.

value.reason: Kept for H-U7 CRP versus temperature.

ref_range.reason: Kept: lab reference range, not an identifier.

sampled_ts.reason: Exact timestamp quasi-identifier; no required task needs lab sampling time.
